usage: - 經營 is mainly used as a noun in business contexts, meaning the running or management of a company or business.
- It often appears in phrases like 經營公司, 經營生意, or 經營業務 when talking about operating a business.
- The word can sound a bit formal, so in everyday speech people may also say 做生意 or 管理 depending on the context.
- For learners, think of 經營 as focusing on the whole operation of a business, not just day-to-day supervision.
